caption: Leaving the heat on all day can dry out the air in our homes. What do you do to keep the air from getting too dry?
comments_seeded: I've noticed my skin gets drier when the heat is on. Anyone else experience that?
I've heard that using a humidifier can help. Has anyone tried one?
Do you find yourself drinking more water when the air is dry?
I've started putting a bowl of water near the heater to add some moisture to the air. Works pretty well.
What are some other ways you keep your home comfortable during the cold weather?
